title: REC-C6 — Close unfinished M1–M4 reconstruction contracts
summary: Advance the convergence sequence from REC-C5 (canonical Agent API surface, 63 → 41 tools) to REC-C6. Close the 9 inherited partial/gap/blocked contracts under REC-C3/REC-C4/REC-C5/REC-C6 owner_gates via inline audit + targeted code fixes. M4A-001 (Go) and M4B-001 (Rust instrumentation) reclassified to blocked with honest deferral notes (no Go crate in workspace, telemetry port not composition-root bound). All other contracts closed: HEX-002/HEX-003 (REC-C3) gap→verified, SOLID-001/CONN-001/CONN-002 (REC-C4) partial→verified, API-001/API-002 (REC-C5) partial→verified. Inline C6.4 fix: enum serde rename_all on TraceSliceKind/StateQueryKind/ExecutionQueryKind (C5.3.1 misshape) + CallGraphResponse wire DTO parity.

findings_introduced.summary: C5.3.1 wrappers were sending snake_case kind values but the v2 server enums (TraceSliceKind/StateQueryKind/ExecutionQueryKind) only had #[schemars(rename_all = "snake_case")] and no serde rename_all — so serde::Deserialize rejected snake_case wire input. Surfaced by sandbox analytics_tools.rs round-trip post-REC-C5.

preconditions: REC-C5 closeout docs/vault commit a097576d advanced active_gate REC-C4 -> REC-C6.
Wire surface 41 tools, ALL_TOOL_NAMES synced with #[tool] router.
